  SELECT SUM(CAST(SUBSTRING("Disbursement Date" FROM 1 FOR 4) AS INTEGER)) AS year, SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)") AS total
  FROM "shg_loan_register"
  WHERE "Disbursement Date" LIKE '2023%'
  GROUP BY 1
),
y2024 AS (
  SELECT SUM(CAST(SUBSTRING("Disbursement Date" FROM 1 FOR 4) AS INTEGER)) AS year, SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)") AS total
  FROM "shg_loan_register"

  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 
  (y2024.total - y2023.total) * 100.0 / NULLIF(y2023.total, 0) AS percent_growth
FROM y2023, y2024;
